scoring_note: The frozen checker rejects inventory Linden solely because flat fee was not in the unit allowlist. The native pipeline returns no blocking errors and the correct invoice. Keep the original checker output; do not treat that label as a lost charge. Seiwa's two blank work descriptions are a real inventory regression.

course.json.cost_scope: Transfer, digest verification, pinned blob acquisition, private runtime and actual Ledgerly model requests; no warmup.

recovery-course.json.correction: Restore all56 original file modes after object transfer; model and runtime bytes unchanged.

completion.json.time_scope: Full admission durations include transfer, staging, serving and waiting; not CPU utilization or inference-only timings.

model-process-observation.json.rss_sum_scope: current descendant RSS; shared pages may be counted more than once, not total peak

final-model-process-observation.json.stop: SIGTERM to exact owned controller; no inference request

cost_interpretation.setup_components_exclude: Sender publication, failure discovery/mode restoration, readiness polling and waiting are not completely measured. Admission wall times overlap staging, serving and caller inference; do not add them as separate sequential phases.
cost_interpretation.initial_copy_source: Sable controller owner reported its original private-copy observation; recovered copy and other timing fields are retained above.
